about: Pickering is a lakeshore city in Durham Region, immediately east of Toronto at the mouth of Duffins Creek. Frenchman’s Bay and a nuclear generating station mark the waterfront; newer neighbourhoods spread north toward the planned Seaton community. GO Transit and Highway 401 make it a major eastern gateway to the GTA. About 99,000 people live in Pickering.
